items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Al Jolson, he used to come in here at them times, he'd sing at the Tulane Show.

ctx.x: You said they paraded in the streets huh?

Yeah, Neil O'Brien and he used to advertise the ministers when they come in. Al Jolson, he used to come in here at them times, he'd sing at the Tulane Show. And we had a colored minister, I can't think its name now.
Did you ever see Butter Beans and Susie?
